title: Developers launch free Adobe Creative Suite clones using AI, breaking its subscription model
summary: Several open-source projects replicate Photoshop, Premiere, and Illustrator with AI, offering free alternatives following frustration over Adobe's fees.

title: Anthropic bans abusive treatment of Claude and updates its usage policies
summary: The company will sanction users who insult or harass its AI model, expanding restrictions against misuse and election interference.

title: U.S. blocks green card process for Microsoft and Adobe H-1B workers over labor fraud
summary: The Department of Labor suspends labor certification after detecting irregularities, affecting major tech companies and their foreign employees.

title: South Korea detects AI use in cyberattacks against its major banks
summary: AI tools allowed a single attacker to breach multiple financial entities, according to researchers and authorities.

title: Sony sells all its virtual reality patents to Meta and exits the VR market
summary: After months of PSVR 2 shortages, PlayStation transfers its patent portfolio to Meta, signaling its exit from the sector.

title: AMD raises price of its Radeon GPUs in China up to $104, except the RX 9070 XT
summary: The increase affects several models as the company seeks to secure HBM memory supply through an alliance with Samsung.

title: OpenAI revenue report causes Nvidia, Oracle, and CoreWeave shares to fall
summary: OpenAI's downward-revised projections trigger a massive sell-off in stocks tied to AI infrastructure.

title: Mathematicians call for boycott of OpenAI for flooding their field with AI-generated proofs
summary: The academic community denounces that OpenAI's models produce flawed proofs that contaminate mathematical literature.

title: Samsung multiplies quarterly profit by nine thanks to AI boom
summary: Demand for memory chips for data centers drives a historic record in the semiconductor industry.

title: AMD seeks broader partnership with Samsung to secure HBM memory supply
summary: In exchange, Samsung asks AMD to manufacture its CPUs and GPUs in its foundries, tightening supply chain ties.

title: AI model evaluator Arena nearly doubles valuation to $3.1 billion in 10 months
summary: The benchmarking platform consolidates as an industry reference, attracting major investment.

title: Xbox creates XP division to bring its games to film, merchandising, and theme parks
summary: The new structure aims to expand Microsoft's franchises beyond the console, following the transmedia model.

title: Sentenced to 18 months in prison for using 10,000 bots to stream his AI-generated songs
summary: The streaming fraud netted him $8 million before being detected by platforms.

title: Finland orders Google to halt construction of two AI data centers over deforestation
summary: Authorities demand full environmental reviews before allowing Google's infrastructure expansion.

title: A modder brings RTX Remix and DLSS 5 to Bloodborne on PC exceeding 90 FPS
summary: The community manages to implement ray tracing and advanced upscaling in the FromSoftware game without an official port.

title: AMD will bring FSR 4 with lightweight AI model to handheld consoles and PC APUs before 2026
summary: The upscaling technology will reach devices with iGPUs, improving performance on less powerful hardware.

title: Sony patents AI final bosses that learn from the player and adaptively increase difficulty
summary: The system memorizes gameplay patterns and adjusts the challenge on each retry to personalize the experience.
